t: Bosch Hex-9 versatile drill bit with sharp centring tip and advanced geometry for accurate drilling in hard materials such as tile and granite. Features a high-performance carbide tip manufactured through fine grinding. Can be used in impact mode on concrete and stone, and in rotary setting for brick, tile, sheet metal, wood and plastic. Includes an optimised dust extraction channel for efficient drilling, and a hex shank for maximum power transfer in standard 3-jaw drills and hexagonal drill driver chucks. 14 x 250mm.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Soft Tiles, Steel, Softwood & Plastics
